chapters.title: ARA Garage Experiment Build Book (GX-PL-01)
chapters.html:
Status: Architecture / Prototype (buildable)

Audit ID: T2-002 · Tier 2

Verified plain English: Falsifiable garage-lab protocol: sand-filled cinder-block bench + Thorlabs Michelson (HeNe, BS013, PDA36A2, SR830) + 50 g gold-coated tungsten on piezo approach to SiN membrane. Map Newtonian 1/r² then look for α_H Yukawa residual (α_H=1/3, ℓ_H=87.953 μm). Predicted BEC Raman phase Δφ=16.08 rad with null |Δφ|<0.2 rad. Stage 1 BOM ~$5,867 used-market. Explicitly a kill-test plan — science practice done right.

A falsifiable garage-lab protocol: start with a Michelson interferometer and a 50 g gold-coated tungsten mass on a sand-filled cinder-block bench, then (if Stage 1 works) move toward UHV + ⁸⁷Rb BEC. Predicted phase Δφ=16.08 rad with a clear null criterion. Written so a determined builder can buy used parts (~$6k Stage 1).

Decoded metaphor: "Garage" literally means DIY optical table — not a metaphor.

Also known as: ARA-GX-PL-01, garage build book, Stage 1 Yukawa

chapters.title: Phase 0 / 11 Matrix Tables
chapters.html:
Status: Architecture / Prototype (buildable)

Audit ID: T2-003 · Tier 2

Verified plain English: Concrete rule Brandon wrote: variables (a,b,c,x,y,z) with a+b=c; x,y manipulate a,b; z is new original value. Table 1 = originals; tables 2–10 each substitute z into one of 9 cells; table 11 completes the evolution pass; feedback loop feeds outputs back as inputs ('non-stop like life'). As AGI/self-evolving intelligence this is TOO LINEAR (Google AI Mode correctly noted linearity limits). As a BUILDABLE product: a phone/web worksheet engine for multi-step reasoning, bot memory slots, or Bot Stage Focus coverage — genuinely smart scaffolding.

A set of tabular/matrix frameworks (about 11 tables) used as a Phase-0 foundation for recursive linear coordinate logic with custom variable rules.

Decoded metaphor: Tables are structured reasoning scaffolds, not magic.

Also known as: 11 Matrix Tables, Matrix Tables, linear coordinate matrice table system
